{{Quote|I am General Gurveer, commander of the Third Battalion, and I'm taking it upon myself to win House Panteer's allegiance to the Empire.|Gurveer|<ref name="Savior">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|Savior|Alderaan}}</ref>}}
'''Third Battalion''' was a military unit of the [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaanian]] noble [[House of Thul|House Thul]]. It was led by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Gurveer]] during the [[Alderaan Civil War|civil war]] in [[3643 BBY]].<ref name="Savior" />
